description: A fiscal-year corporation REFUSES: the OBBBA parameters (SS 250 rates, SS 59A 10.5%, SS 960(d) 90%, SS 448(c) $32M, the 1% charitable floor, SS 179 amounts) apply by the taxable year's BEGINNING date while this corpus selects rules by calendar date, and SS 443(b) annualization / SS 15 proration are not encoded. A fiscal filer straddling 12/31/2025 would otherwise silently get the wrong year's parameters.
